title: POST /mandate-drafts/{id}/validate (result)
description: A4: every violation, as the envelope's shared Violation (a schema finding, a V-rule, or a policy key naming its value and the nearest ancestor it breaks, mandate spec §4.3), and every warning with its code to acknowledge one by one (§4.2). It writes nothing. A draft is valid exactly when nothing is violated. docs/specs/workspace-api.md §4.1, §4.10 (DEC-742).
